name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
summary: In Desolace, Kreldig Ungor gathers reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos. The Reclaimers are short-handed, so he begins with claws and horns from the Hatefury satyrs to the east.

sections.title: Leftwitch's List
sections.body: After Reclaimers' Business in Desolace, Kreldig Ungor takes on another job. He gathers reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage who lives in Kharanos. Roetten calls it easy coin because the Reclaimers are already in Desolace. The crew is short-handed, but Kreldig says he does not care.

sections.title: Horns and Claws
sections.body: Kreldig begins with ten claws and ten horns from the Hatefury satyrs to the east. They dwell in the Sargeron ruins, due east of Nijel's Point. Once you have the claws and horns, the rest of Leftwitch's list can begin.

aliases: reagents for reclaimers inc quest giver
faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor gathers reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage who lives in Kharanos. Roetten calls it easy coin because the Reclaimers are already in Desolace.

faq.q: Where are the Hatefury satyrs located?
faq.answer: The Hatefury satyrs are in the Sargeron ruins, due east of Nijel's Point.

faq.q: What does Kreldig want from the satyrs?
aliases: what do i need to collect
faq.answer: Kreldig wants ten Hatefury claws and ten Hatefury horns. With them, you and Kreldig can move on to the next items on Leftwitch's list.

faq.q: What does Kreldig think about satyrs?
faq.answer: Kreldig calls the satyrs despicable creatures. He has heard they are linked somehow to the night elves, though he doubts it. He believes the story comes from the one elf who brought them into the war a few years ago. Since then, he thinks the world has grown more dangerous and frightening.
